newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re shares surge after M&G purchase.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re shares surge after M&G purchase.

text.p: Shares in Swiss Reinsurance Co continued Tuesday's upward surge in early, active trading on the Swiss Exchange on Wednesday on bullish sentiment following its 1.7 billion sterling acquisition of Mercantile & General Re (M&G) from Britain's Prudential Corp.
At 0840 GMT Swiss Re's registered shares were up 25 Swiss francs, or 1.9 percent to 1,326 francs in an otherwise weaker market. On Tuesday the shares gained 31 francs.
Dealers said analysts were likely to raise their estimates for Swiss Re following the acquisition and further gains in the share price were likely.
Swiss Re said on Tuesday the purchase of M&G would contribute substantially to its earnings and support its goal of a 15 percent return on equity (ROE).
The deal is likely to support the share in the medium term as such strategic decisions do not just lead to short term rises in the stock price, dealers said.
However, they cautioned that profit taking could set in.
Dealers also said the share easily overcame technical resistance at 1,290 francs on Tuesday, adding further momentum.
The next point of resistance is seen at 1,350, which dealers expect will be overcome after some initial consolidation.
